<thought>The 13C NMR shows only one signal in the typical aliphatic methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm) at 19.23 ppm, suggesting a single CH₃ group. Other upfield signals (≈40‑55 ppm) could correspond to carbons attached to heteroatoms, but without DEPT or additional data we cannot confirm they are methyls. Therefore, the safest answer is that there is 1 methyl group.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
